weapons.name: NeutronBlaster
weapons.damageFormula:
switch($this->firingMode){
			case 1:
				 Dice::d(10, 1)+10 // fired individually, twice per blaster
			case 2:
				 Dice::d(10, 3)+30 // 1 shot from 2 combined blasters
			case 3:	
				 Dice::d(10, 7)+70 // 1 shot from 3 combined blasters
			default: //should never go here
